title: Poached Eggs with Broccoli & Seeded Toast
description: Poached eggs with steamed broccoli and grilled tomatoes on seeded wholemeal flatbread.
steps: Blanch the broccoli 2 minutes, add the tomatoes for 30 seconds, then set aside.
Poach the eggs in gently simmering water for 2.5-3 minutes.
Pile the vegetables onto the flatbread, top with eggs, seeds, oil and chilli flakes.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food poached eggs with broccoli

notes: A genuinely light option under 250 kcal that still hits a solid protein number — good on a lower-calorie day.
